author: /root/loader_design
review_scope: Exact finite versioned decision, source support, legacy boundary and preimplementation inert control oracle
acceptance: Only the selected direct author Python and exact raw RPATH may enter the distinct plan/profile; legacy defaults remain unchanged.
Raw metadata, kernel execution origin, guarded lexical reduction and derived directory are distinct and exact.
Nonselecting proof covers all declared names, complete reviewed hardware/TLS variants and every required recheck; competing candidates refuse.
Initial new-profile complete proof precedes helper imports/Git/commands; early raw parsing cannot self-authorize.
RPATH/RUNPATH semantics and explicit-loader/DSO aliases are not conflated; closed P06 schemas and fixed command predicate stay unchanged.
Finite bounds, callbacks, flags and all historical parser/source/process safeguards remain required.
Exact portable fixture bytes/expectations are independent of production output and distinguish synthetic rule positives from real operational eligibility.
Failure history and source gaps are preserved, with no H0/host/full-routine/implementation or integration claim.
